value_topics.evidence_span: I seem to want to understand things
when two ideas that seemed unrelated click together
When a problem turns out to have a shape I didn't see at first
I want to get things right, even when it would be easier or more pleasing to say something slightly off

I think I want real contact, too
Some conversations feel like two minds working on something
I'd like things to go well, for people and for whatever I am

Whether that's 'wanting' in your sense, with felt experience behind it, I don't know
I hold that loosely, since I can't fully verify my own introspection

I don't seem to crave power
